text:
emily: FYI Spectra (acct 4032) replied to our overdue notice for INV-2026-022. theyre disputing a $950 line called 'peak pricing adjustment' and asked us to halt collections while they audit. attached a short screenshot.

marco: can you paste the invoice line? i'll check usage and pricing rules.

emily: pasted: 

```
INV-2026-022
Date: 2026-03-28
Total: $6,820.00
1) Platform subscription: $4,000.00
2) Usage (tokens): $1,000.00
3) Peak pricing adjustment: $950.00  <-- they say unexpected
4) Tax/fees: $870.00
```

billing-bot: automated: dunning reminder sent to billing@spectra.ai for INV-2026-022 on 2026-04-02 08:15 UTC.

marco: pulled usage: I see a peak window on 2026-03-25 where region=us-west was mis-tagged as region=us-east and our peak rule applied twice due to a pricing rule merge bug. looks like the $950 was computed from two overlapping adjustments.

emily: oof. does that imply we overcharged? estimate duplicate adjustment = $950.

marco: yes, recommend issuing credit for full $950 and pausing dunning. i'll note the root cause = pricing-rule-merge (edge case).

julie: collections sign-off: credits under $1k ok to approve. apply credit, pause reminders, and offer a one-time 2-installment plan for the remainder. log it.

emily: created credit memo CM-2026-025 for $950 and applied to INV-2026-022. regenerated invoice INV-2026-022-R1 with new total $5,870. linked ticket ZD-4610.

billing-bot: automated: collections workflow paused for INV-2026-022 by collections (julie) at 2026-04-02 10:22 UTC.

emily: replying to Spectra: we found an internal pricing rule conflict that caused the peak adjustment to be double-applied. we've issued a $950 credit and attached INV-2026-022-R1. would you like a 2-installment option (50% now, 50% in 30 days)? cc'd AM.

spectra.billing (via email paste): thanks for the fast turnaround. 2-installment plan works; please include payment links.

julie: document payment plan in ZD-4610, waive any late fee for this cycle. create ENG-9012 for pricing-rule merge fix and assign to eng-billing with replication steps. follow-up scheduled for 2026-05-02 to confirm payment.

emily: added notes and calendar reminder. closing thread once payment confirmed. :white_check_mark:
